title: IDD Persona front-matter
description: Schema for the YAML front-matter of an IDD persona artifact (Markdown body is freeform).

refs.description: Open-ended map of reference kinds to values. Keys are not enumerated because cross-artifact reference vocabulary evolves; closed-world checks operate on the structured tier.

conformanceNotes.description: Free-text note explaining the conformance tier (e.g., a tracking issue for promotion).
